bio: Discover Boat House, set against the beautiful waterside views of Chichester Harbour where the provenance of ingredients lies at the heart of every dish. The menu is inspired by the bountiful produce surrounding the region, be it land or sea.  Experience a laid-back Afternoon Tea that’s all about pure indulgence! Picture this: a delightful selection of finger sandwiches to kick things off, followed by a mouthwatering variety of homemade cakes that’ll satisfy your sweet cravings. And then there are the warm, freshly baked scones, paired perfectly with clotted cream and jam. But that’s not all – with unlimited tea and coffee flowing, you can take your time, sip, and savour every moment.  Whether you’re celebrating or simply unwinding, the Afternoon Tea is a delicious journey you won’t want to miss. To elevate your experience, enjoy an added glass of Prosecco.  Boat House is located in Chichester Harbour, the perfect spot to relax and catch up with friends or stop by on a walk. It is just outside Chichester and not far from Chichester Station.
